rows.name: Unified Doctor engine (check, repair, resume)
rows.expected_outcome: Reports versioned readiness, runs serialized safe repairs (<=2 attempts), journals interrupted runs for resume, and scrubs logs.
rows.observable_assertion: dt doctor check/repair/resume --json returns schema=1 with run_id, checks, and redacted_log_location; web/mobile receive sanitized status only.

rows.name: macOS signed .pkg inside ARM64 and Intel DMGs
rows.expected_outcome: Installs DT.app and DTCUHelper.app together via Install DT.pkg, passes Gatekeeper, starts user setup at first launch, preserves Keychain & permissions across upgrades.
rows.observable_assertion: hdiutil attach verifies Install DT.pkg; spctl --assess passes; LaunchAgents register in user gui domain.

rows.name: Windows NSIS 3.13 installer, per-user tasks, SID-restricted pipes, WHPX resume
rows.expected_outcome: Installs under Program Files, adds Start menu & Installed Apps entries, uses SID-restricted named pipes rejecting remote clients, enables WHPX and resumes via dt doctor resume.
rows.observable_assertion: Authenticode signature verified on installer/uninstaller/binaries; named pipe rejects non-owner SID and remote clients.

rows.name: Ubuntu 24.04 .deb graphical install and user systemd units
rows.expected_outcome: Installs cleanly through App Center/apt on Ubuntu 24.04 with declared dependencies, registers graphical-session user units, and passes X11 and Wayland checks.
rows.observable_assertion: dpkg-deb -I validates depends & desktop entry; systemd user units start in graphical-session.target.

rows.name: v0.7.0 data migration, conflict preservation, rollback, and signed component catalog
rows.expected_outcome: Snapshots SQLite consistently under storage lease, preserves both stores on legacy+DT conflict, rolls back package+snapshot together, verifies chunked component hashes.
rows.observable_assertion: Corrupt/tampered/interrupted component downloads fail closed; schema downgrade is rejected; dual-store conflict preserves both.

rows.name: Primary dt CLI with gm compatibility alias and dt-doctor recovery binary
rows.expected_outcome: All subcommands (chat, permissions, onboard, do, daemon, status, kill, service, doctor, diagnostics, dogfood, stats, review, audit, upkeep, feed, ideas, update, models, bots, queue, channels, team, routines, serve, skills, goals, forget, import-memory, dream, spaces) work identically via dt and gm.
rows.observable_assertion: dt --help and gm --help expose full command set; dt doctor works independently via dt-doctor even if daemon is stopped.

rows.name: ChatGPT OAuth PKCE & Responses streaming
rows.expected_outcome: Connects via PKCE, stores token durably, fetches /v1/models, streams /v1/responses, records included allowance, handles renewal, switch, revocation, expiry, cancellation, disconnect.
rows.observable_assertion: State transitions CredentialsSaved -> Authenticated -> CatalogLoaded -> CapabilityVerified; fail-in-place without misleading fallback.

rows.name: OpenAI API key & Responses API
rows.expected_outcome: Stores API key in OS credential store, discovers /v1/models, streams /v1/responses, enforces budget cap.
rows.observable_assertion: Validates origin binding and rejects invalid keys/models visibly.

rows.name: Meta Muse API key & Chat Completions
rows.expected_outcome: Stores key, discovers /v1/models, streams Chat Completions, respects screenshot egress toggle.
rows.observable_assertion: Screenshot egress blocked unless allow_screenshot_egress_meta=true.

rows.name: xAI Grok API key & language models
rows.expected_outcome: Stores key, discovers /v1/language-models, streams Chat Completions, respects screenshot egress toggle.
rows.observable_assertion: Screenshot egress blocked unless allow_screenshot_egress_xai=true.

rows.name: Kilo Gateway API key & catalog
rows.expected_outcome: Stores key, loads ai-gateway.kilo.ai/api/v1/models, streams replies, records usage.
rows.observable_assertion: Catalog fetch separates public listing from verified inference.

rows.name: OpenRouter API key & catalog
rows.expected_outcome: Stores key, loads /api/v1/models, streams replies, records usage.
rows.observable_assertion: Unknown capabilities stay unknown until verified.

rows.name: Nous Portal OAuth device grant & renewal
rows.expected_outcome: Completes device grant, refreshes on 401, discovers models, streams replies, handles revocation & disconnect.
rows.observable_assertion: Refresh token race/revocation clears cached models and surfaces re-auth prompt.

rows.name: Custom/local Chat Completions & Responses endpoints
rows.expected_outcome: Connects to both custom Chat Completions and custom Responses servers, validates origin changes, handles timeouts and partial streams.
rows.observable_assertion: Origin change sets NeedsRevalidation; partial stream never reports CapabilityVerified.

rows.name: LocalVlmBackend (Qwen2-VL-2B, SmolVLM, SmolVLM2 via llama.cpp MTMD & ONNX DirectML)
rows.expected_outcome: On-demand start/unload, CPU/Metal/CUDA/Vulkan/DirectML reporting, explicit CPU fallback reporting, damaged asset & OOM handling, no mock inference in release builds.
rows.observable_assertion: Release builds refuse GM_FORCE_MOCK_LLM; worker reports active accelerator or explicit CPU fallback.

rows.name: Managed Whisper STT and local speech synthesis
rows.expected_outcome: Starts, health-checks, and stops managed speech runtimes over loopback-authenticated transport with bounded audio buffers, consent gating, and barge-in/revocation.
rows.observable_assertion: Audio buffers exceeding cap fail closed; revoking consent stops capture immediately.

rows.name: Desktop automation (ScreenCaptureKit/WGC/X11/PipeWire, AX/UIA/AT-SPI, input, clipboard, notifications, Take the Wheel)
rows.expected_outcome: Accurate coordinate mapping across mixed scaling and negative monitor origins, locked-window handling, hotplug & mid-task revocation, emergency stop <100ms.
rows.observable_assertion: All 10 desktop acceptance tasks and hot-path p95/p99 targets pass on all 5 desktop targets.

rows.name: Isolated VM coding & CLI-agent egress broker (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build)
rows.expected_outcome: Offline guest has zero host mounts/shell/network; CLI profile uses job-scoped provider proxy with host-held keys, metered requests, capped output, tree kill, and digest-checked patch apply.
rows.observable_assertion: Unapproved egress hosts denied; patch conflict rejected; process tree cancelled cleanly.

rows.name: Research citations, multi-bot channels, Pages/Spaces, memory, forget, goals, routines, attachments
rows.expected_outcome: Preserves provenance, prevents duplicate external effects across DST/restarts, enforces bounded image/PDF previews, and runs scheduled routines safely.
rows.observable_assertion: Duplicate delivery_id returns duplicate without re-execution; PDF/image preview bounded and sanitized.

rows.name: Connectors (Gmail, Calendar, GitHub, email, 1Password, native EventKit, MCP stdio/HTTPS) & bridges (Slack, Teams, Discord, Telegram)
rows.expected_outcome: Honest capability probing, grant/revoke/reconnect, signed relay replay rejection, and deny-wins outbound discretion.
rows.observable_assertion: Replay envelopes rejected; unconfigured connectors report unconfigured.

rows.name: Voice, Asterisk SIP trunk, Zoom RTMS, and Google Meet notes
rows.expected_outcome: Consent gated, SIP transfer/cleanup with Tier-3 cost gate, Zoom RTMS transcript delivery, Google Meet live desktop audio notes + REST event/transcript lookup.
rows.observable_assertion: No PSTN transfer without explicit approval; Google Meet uses consented local capture + supported APIs.

rows.name: Marketplace plugins (github-pr-helper, calendar-brief) & server-side Stripe billing
rows.expected_outcome: Pre-install scope confirmation, install/update/remove/rollback, server-side Stripe secret & price allowlist, HMAC webhook idempotency, free self-hosted BYOK.
rows.observable_assertion: Client-supplied stripe_secret_key or unapproved checkout URLs rejected; webhook replay is idempotent.

rows.name: Hosted PostgreSQL + membership RBAC + AES-256-GCM/HKDF + HttpOnly Secure sessions + CSRF + digest-pinned deploy
rows.expected_outcome: SQLx PostgreSQL stores workspaces/memberships/sessions/enrollments/backups; AES-256-GCM + HKDF authenticates tenant secrets; every HTTP route & SSE enforces membership; web uses HttpOnly Secure cookies + CSRF (no bearer token in browser storage).
rows.observable_assertion: Wrong-tenant access returns 403; tampered ciphertext fails GCM auth; mutations without CSRF token fail 403.

rows.name: Unified Rakazo design tokens across native egui, Companion, React Web, and Expo SDK 58 Mobile
rows.expected_outcome: Single source generates all 4 clients; preserves 316px sidebar (240-480 resize, 72 collapsed), drafts, loading/empty/denied/offline/stale/error states, 4.5:1/3:1 contrast.
rows.observable_assertion: Token generator diff passes in CI; web build/tests and mobile Expo SDK 58 contract tests pass.

rows.name: Shipped core skills (artifacts, device-data, forget, goals, self-awareness, skill-creator, spaces, wide-research) & custom skill amendment
rows.expected_outcome: All bundled skills pass SHA-256 manifest verification, progressive disclosure loading, and safe custom amendment.
rows.observable_assertion: SkillRegistry loads all bundled skills with verified hashes.

rows.name: Immutable release assets + renewable signed update-metadata branch
rows.expected_outcome: Validates OS signer + SHA-256 + monotonic sequence + future expiry + expected repo origin + revocation list; installs via Doctor with compatible rollback.
rows.observable_assertion: Expired, rolled-back, revoked, wrong-origin, or wrong-target metadata is rejected.
